svg.text: AIRFARE PRICE PREDICTION & FARE PATTERN ANALYSIS
MySQL Relational Entity-Relationship (ER) Schema Diagram • Database: airfare_prediction_db

g.text: • PRIMARY KEY (id) - Unique auto-incrementing log ID
• INDEX idx_session (session_id) - Quick lookup per browser session
• INDEX idx_created_at (created_at) - Temporal audit trail & history
• Allows anonymous users to save, compare & annotate flights
• Satisfies full CRUD operations without requiring account login
• Compares Linear Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest & XGBoost
• Feeds model leaderboard cards & radar comparison charts in UI

svg.text: Engine: InnoDB • Encoding: utf8mb4_unicode_ci • ACID Compliant • Indexed for sub-millisecond route & session queries
